customMethods.name: exportRoutes
customMethods.script:
# implement your method here		
	''' 
 		Exports lot route information and associated data such as route steps and items
 		 
 		Args: 
 			itemIds (list[int]): list of itemIds
 		Returns: 
 			exportInfo (dict) 
 			message (string): None if successful 
 		Updated: 
 			jz  10/14/25 created
 	'''
 	dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('core') 
 	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_lot')
 	
	import java.lang
	
	routeIds = [row['routeId'] for row in self.view.custom.routes.selectedData]
 	log.info("exportRoutes() called with %s"%(routeIds)) 
 	exportInfo = {}
 	
 	try:
		routes = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getRoutes({'routeIdList': routeIds}))
		for route in routes:
			routeItem = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemId': route['itemId']}))
			route['itemInfo'] = routeItem[0] if len(routeItem) else None
		routeSteps = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getRouteSteps({'routeIdList': routeIds}))
		for routeStep in routeSteps:
			routeStepLotOp = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotOperations({'lotOperationId': routeStep['lotOperationId']}))
			routeStep['lotOperationInfo'] = routeStepLotOp[0] if len(routeStepLotOp) else None
		
 		exportInfo['routes'] = routes
		exportInfo['routeSteps'] = routeSteps
	 	
 		data = system.util.jsonDecode(str(system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)))
 		fileName = 'Routes Export ({}).json'.format(system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
	
		document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'routesInfo', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
		system.perspective.download(fileName, document)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Routes exported'})
 		 
 	except java.lang.Exception, e:
 		log.error("exportLotOperations() threw exception %s "%(e.cause))
 		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Routes failed to export: %s'%e.cause})
	
	return

customMethods.name: duplicateRoute
customMethods.script:
if (routeId or None) is None: return
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	routeInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getRoutes({'routeId': routeId}), 0)
	routeSteps = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getRouteSteps({'routeId': routeId}))
	
	routeInfo['routeId'] = None
	routeInfo['routeName'] = routeInfo['routeName'] + '_copy_%s'%system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'YY-MM-dd HH:mm')
	
	routeId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addRoute(routeInfo, userId)
	if msg:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', payload={'message': 'Failed to add route. %s '%(msg)})
		return
	
	# Adding route steps
	for routeStep in routeSteps:
		routeStep = dict(routeStep)
		routeStep['routeStepId'] = None
		routeStep['routeId'] = routeId
		routeStepId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addRouteStep(routeStep, userId)
		if msg:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', payload={'message': 'Failed to add route step. %s '%(msg)})
			return
				
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': 'Route has been duplicated'})
	
	self.view.custom.routes.row = None
	self.view.custom.routes.col = None	
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.routes.data")
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
'''
		Imports all route info including route steps (kanoaOPS)
		Args:
			exportInfo: dict
			userId: int
		Returns:
			success: bit
			msg: string
		Updated:
			10/14/25 JZ Created
	'''
	system.perspective.print('import routes received')
	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaLotImporter')
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	exportInfo = payload['exportInfo']['data']
		
	import java.lang
		
	roleId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('roleId', system.kanoa.security.getRoles({'roleName': 'Administrator'}))
	if not (exportInfo.has_key('routes') and exportInfo.has_key('routeSteps')):
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Import data does not have the expected fields')
		return
	
	# add route data
	routesAdded = 0
	itemsAdded = 0
	itemClassesAdded = 0
	routes = exportInfo['routes']
	routesIdMap = {}
	itemsIdMap = {}
	itemClassIdMap = {}
	for route in routes:
		routeInfo = dict(route)
		itemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemPath': routeInfo['itemPath']}))
		newRouteItemInfo = dict(routeInfo['itemInfo'])
		if itemId: itemsIdMap[routeInfo['itemId']] = itemId
		else:
			# Need to create all the item classes needed for the item...
			itemClassPath = routeInfo['itemInfo']['itemClassPath']
			itemClassPathParts = []
			itemClassPaths = {}
			for part in itemClassPath.split('\\'):
				itemClassPathParts.append(part)		
				classPath = '\\'.join(itemClassPathParts)
				if classPath in itemClassPaths: continue
				itemClassPaths[classPath] = {'itemClassPath': classPath, 'itemClassColor': routeInfo['itemInfo']['itemClassColor'] if classPath == routeInfo['itemInfo']['itemClassPath'] else None}
			
			for itemClassInfo in sorted(itemClassPaths.values(), key=lambda x: x['itemClassPath']):
				itemClassId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': itemClassInfo['itemClassPath']}))
				if itemClassId: 
					itemClassIdMap[newRouteItemInfo['itemClassId']] = itemClassId
					continue
				
				pathSplit = itemClassInfo['itemClassPath'].split('\\')
				parentPath = '\\'.join(pathSplit[:-1]) if len(pathSplit) > 1 else None
				parentId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': parentPath})) if parentPath else None		
				itemClassInfo = {'itemClassName': pathSplit[-1], 'parentId': parentId, 'itemClassDescription': None, 'itemClassColor': itemClassInfo['itemClassColor'], 'enabled': True}		
				newItemClassId = system.kanoa.item.addItemClass(itemClassInfo, userId)
				itemClassesAdded += 1
				itemClassIdMap[newRouteItemInfo['itemClassId']] = newItemClassId
			
			newRouteItemInfo['itemClassId'] = itemClassIdMap[routeInfo['itemInfo']['itemClassId']]
			newItemId = system.kanoa.item.addItem(newRouteItemInfo, userId)
			itemsAdded += 1
			itemsIdMap[routeInfo['itemId']] = newItemId
		
		routeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('routeId', system.kanoa.lot.getRoutes({'routeName': routeInfo['routeName'], 'itemId': itemsIdMap[routeInfo['itemId']]}))
		if not routeId:
			routeInfo['itemId'] = itemsIdMap[routeInfo['itemId']]
			routeInfo['itemClassId'] = itemClassIdMap[newRouteItemInfo['itemClassId']] if itemClassIdMap.has_key(newRouteItemInfo['itemClassId']) else newRouteItemInfo['itemClassId']
			newRouteId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addRoute(routeInfo, userId)
			routesAdded += 1
			routesIdMap[routeInfo['routeId']] = newRouteId
		else:
			routesIdMap[routeInfo['routeId']] = routeId
	
	# Adding route steps
	routeSteps = exportInfo['routeSteps']
	routeStepsAdded = 0
	lotOperationIdMap = {}
	lotOperationsAdded = 0
	for routeStep in routeSteps:
		routeStepInfo = dict(routeStep)
		lotOperationId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotOperationId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotOperations({'lotOperationName': routeStepInfo['lotOperationName']}))
		if lotOperationId: lotOperationIdMap[routeStepInfo['lotOperationId']] = lotOperationId
		else:
			newLotOperationId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLotOperation(routeStepInfo['lotOperationInfo'], userId)
			lotOperationIdMap[routeStepInfo['lotOperationId']] = newLotOperationId
			lotOperationsAdded += 1
		
		routeStepId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('routeStepId', system.kanoa.lot.getRouteSteps({'routeId': routesIdMap[routeStepInfo['routeId']], 'lotOperationId': lotOperationIdMap[routeStepInfo['lotOperationId']]}))
		if not routeStepId:
			routeStepInfo['routeId'] = routesIdMap[routeStepInfo['routeId']]
			routeStepInfo['lotOperationId'] = lotOperationIdMap[routeStepInfo['lotOperationId']]
			system.kanoa.lot.addRouteStep(routeStepInfo, userId)
			routeStepsAdded += 1
				
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': '%s routes, %s route steps, %s items, %s item classes, %s lotOperations'%(routesAdded, routeStepsAdded, itemsAdded, itemClassesAdded, lotOperationsAdded)})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.routes.data")
	
	return {'passed': True, 'message': 'Routes imported'}
